seed_scope: Ten new fixed independent initialization/minibatch streams; descriptive algorithmic variation, not a population guarantee for arbitrary optimizers or hyperparameters.
population_weights: uniform over nine fixed balance-sheet profiles; not an empirical population
primary_comparison: same announced fitting wall budget, including validation and checkpointing; finish the current iteration, record overshoot, actual simulator visits, updates, verification and deployment work
reporting: Retain all fitted candidates, selected checkpoints, failures, negative/inconclusive endpoints and every final raw array. Do not select policies on final data. Historical R11 reanalysis is separately labelled retrospective.
publication_gate: Clean numerical execution, identity and hash checks, tests and compilation. Positive economic endpoints are reported outcomes, never software pass conditions.
secondary_environment: Ubuntu 22.04, seed 7919, fixed 80/160 iterations, dimensions 10 and 50; same numerical versions; compare hashes and achieved endpoints, not wall-clock identity
protocol_status: R12 final design carried forward and extended before any R13 final outcome; development and final banks remain separate; not a historical preregistration
